title: Changes from Vanilla
description:
This pack changes quite of few of Vanilla's mechanics. Many of those changes are described in other chapters of this guide. Here are some changes that didn't really fit into any other chapter:

Combat:

There are no swords. Nor bows, crossbows, or arrows. No hostile mobs spawn in this pack (except the Ender Dragon, if you actually pursue The End, or The Wither, if you deliberately summon it, but I do not know where you would get the skulls). The Warden is disabled. Pillagers/Illagers and their structures have been completely removed.

Villages:

Villages too, have been removed. Your economy is powered by the Shipping Bin and the Wandering Trader. Sell with the former to purchase from the latter.

Logging:

Chop trees from the bottom block to fell the whole tree at once.

Enchantments:

Enchantments that are only useful in combat, such as Smite or Sharpness, have been removed. You will not find their books, nor will you roll them on the Enchanting Table. This means a higher chance of rolling utility enchantments, like Unbreaking, Fortune, or Mending. That's right! Mending has also been added as an option to the Enchanting Table.
Mending Bonus: Sneak-right-click while holding a tool enchanted with Mending, to repair it using your stored Experience.
